adjustments.description: Settlement of a commercial dispute. Non-recurring.
adjustments.management_rationale: Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring. Management advises this relates to a separate matter from FY2023 and FY2024 settlements.
adjustments.reasoning: The underlying economic event (a legal settlement) is affirmatively supported by Board Minutes Item 7 (DOC-09), which independently records that 'the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners had been concluded at $2.1M, consistent with the prior two years.' The amount $2.1M is corroborated by the board record. However, the board minutes also describe this as the 'third annual settlement' in an 'ongoing series', and the board itself asked whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026. The same category, same amount ($2,100,000), and same rationale ('Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring') appears identically in FY2023 (ADJ-001), FY2024 (ADJ-002), and FY2025 (ADJ-003). Three consecutive years of identical $2.1M settlements labelled 'non-recurring' each year, combined with the board's own discussion of a potential FY2026 settlement, constitutes strong evidence of a recurring pattern. Management's 'non-recurring' label is contradicted by the structural evidence. The adjustment cannot be fully accepted as a clean non-recurring add-back. However, because the board minutes do independently confirm the FY2025 settlement event and amount, and because the appropriate treatment (partial acceptance, full rejection, or full challenge pending further evidence) requires a determination of whether the underlying disputes are truly separate matters or a continuing series - a determination that requires legal documentation not available in the current data room - the verdict is Challenged. The accepted amount cannot be quantified without additional evidence (settlement agreements, legal documentation distinguishing the matters).

amount.detail: Amount of $2,100,000 confirmed by board minutes. However, the recurring pattern challenges whether this amount should be added back as non-recurring.

adjustments.description: Planned headcount reduction of 14 FTE scheduled for Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.

adjustments.reasoning: Management explicitly states in the QoE schedule that no notice has yet been served and the headcount reduction is planned for Q1 FY2026. This is a prospective, unactioned cost saving. The adjustment represents a future cost reduction that had not occurred as of the FY2025 reporting date. Pro-forma adjustments for unactioned future cost savings are not appropriate EBITDA add-backs in a QoE context without affirmative evidence that the savings are contractually committed, legally obligated, or otherwise certain. No board resolution approving the redundancy programme, no restructuring plan, no legal notices, and no payroll evidence supporting the quantum are available in the data room. The structured data contains no evidence of this programme. The adjustment is Rejected: management's own description confirms the event had not occurred in FY2025.

adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: This adjustment is a pro-forma annualisation of in-year new logo revenue. SQL analysis identifies 20 new logos (customers with first_order_date in FY2025) generating $1,878,956 of actual in-year FY2025 revenue. Management's claimed annualisation amount is $1,650,000. The actual in-year revenue ($1,878,956) exceeds the management annualisation claim ($1,650,000), which is an inconsistency. However, the fundamental issue is that annualising in-year new logo revenue requires an assumption that those customers will continue at the same or higher run rate in future periods. This is an assumption-dependent estimate, not a directly reconstructable amount. Historical invoice revenue from new logos does not prove future contractual run-rate revenue. The structured data shows actual in-year revenue but does not establish contracted ARR, committed future spend, or renewal certainty for these 20 new logos. The adjustment methodology (annualisation) requires an unsupported economic assumption about future revenue persistence. Furthermore, pro-forma revenue adjustments that add future revenue not yet earned are not appropriate EBITDA add-backs in a QoE context without affirmative evidence of contracted committed revenue. No contracted ARR schedules, signed order forms, or committed revenue evidence is available for the new logos. The adjustment is Rejected: the annualisation methodology requires an unsupported assumption, and pro-forma future revenue is not an appropriate QoE add-back without contracted commitment evidence.

existence.detail: SQL confirms 20 new logos (first_order_date >= 2025-01-01) with $1,878,956 actual FY2025 in-year revenue. New logo wins are confirmed.

amount.detail: Management claims $1,650,000 annualisation. Actual in-year revenue from new logos is $1,878,956 - exceeding the management figure by $228,956. The annualisation methodology requires an unsupported assumption of future revenue persistence.

period.detail: The adjustment adds future revenue not yet earned in FY2025. Pro-forma annualisation is a forward-looking adjustment, not a FY2025 normalisation.

recurrence.detail: No prior-year pro-forma new logo annualisation in available history.

duplication.detail: No other adjustment covers new logo annualisation.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Signed order forms or contracts for new FY2025 logos confirming committed annual contract value. ARR schedules showing contracted recurring revenue. Evidence that new logos have passed any cancellation window and are committed to full-year spend.

sql_evidence.purpose: Category recurrence analysis across all years
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT category, COUNT(*) as occurrences, SUM(amount_usd) as total_amount, MIN(fiscal_year) as first_year, MAX(fiscal_year) as last_year FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment GROUP BY category ORDER BY occurrences DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: One-time legal settlement: 3 occurrences $6.3M FY2023-FY2025. Transaction costs: 2 occurrences $1.05M FY2024-FY2025. All other categories: 1 occurrence each.

sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, amount_usd, mgmt_rationale FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE category = 'Transaction costs' ORDER BY fiscal_year
sql_evidence.result_summary: ADJ-008 FY2024 $180,000 (aborted refinancing); ADJ-006 FY2025 $870,000 (sell-side adviser fees). Different underlying events.

sql_evidence.purpose: Legacy product revenue test for ADJ-007
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) as legacy_invoice_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.product_family = 'Legacy'
sql_evidence.result_summary: 0 rows. Zero invoice lines for Legacy product family across all periods. Legacy products (PRD-016, PRD-017) exist in dim_product but have no transaction history.

sql_evidence.purpose: New logo FY2025 in-year revenue test for ADJ-010
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_id) as new_logo_count, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) as actual_fy2025_inyr_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON dc.customer_id = fi.customer_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' AND dc.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01'
sql_evidence.result_summary: 20 new logos, $1,878,956 actual FY2025 in-year revenue.

sql_evidence.purpose: New logo revenue vs management annualisation claim comparison
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_id) as new_logo_count, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) as actual_fy2025_inyr_revenue, 1650000 AS mgmt_claimed_annualised_amount, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) - 1650000 AS difference_vs_mgmt FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON dc.customer_id = fi.customer_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' AND dc.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01'
sql_evidence.result_summary: Actual in-year revenue $1,878,956 exceeds management annualisation claim $1,650,000 by $228,956.

sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT 4280000 AS reported_ebitda_usd, 870000 AS accepted_adj_006_transaction_costs, 4280000 + 870000 AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 12400000 AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 12400000 - (4280000 + 870000) AS earnings_challenge_usd

SELECT 4280000 AS reported_ebitda_usd, 8120000 AS mgmt_total_adjustments_usd, 12400000 AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 870000 AS accepted_adjustments_total_usd, 8120000 - 870000 AS challenged_or_rejected_total_usd, 4280000 + 870000 AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 12400000 - (4280000 + 870000) AS earnings_challenge_usd, (4280000 + 8120000) - 12400000 AS mgmt_bridge_reconciliation_diff
sql_evidence.result_summary: Management bridge reconciles (diff=0). Team bridge: reported $4,280,000 + accepted $870,000 = $5,150,000. Earnings challenge = $7,250,000. Challenged/rejected total = $7,250,000.

sql_evidence.purpose: Enterprise Value search in structured sources
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT claim_id, claim_text, metric_key, claimed_value, period FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_claim WHERE LOWER(claim_text) LIKE '%enterprise value%' OR LOWER(claim_text) LIKE '%transaction value%' OR LOWER(claim_text) LIKE '%purchase price%' OR LOWER(metric_key) LIKE '%ev%' OR LOWER(metric_key) LIKE '%enterprise%' OR LOWER(metric_key) LIKE '%valuation%'
sql_evidence.result_summary: No Enterprise Value, transaction value, or purchase price found in mgmt_claim table.

sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) as total_fy2025_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi WHERE fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31'
sql_evidence.result_summary: Total FY2025 revenue: $42,730,073. Consistent with CIM statement of 'over $42M in FY2025'.

unresolved_items.description: Enterprise Value was actively searched in all available authoritative deal documents (CIM DOC-01, QoE schedule DOC-08, mgmt_claim structured table) and was not found. Implied EBITDA multiples cannot be calculated. EV must be sourced from an authoritative deal input before multiples can be reported.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Obtain explicit Enterprise Value from deal terms, LOI, or authoritative transaction document.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-003 (legal settlement $2.1M) is Challenged. The event is confirmed by board minutes but the recurring pattern prevents full acceptance. The appropriate retained amount requires legal documentation distinguishing the three settlement matters. accepted_amount_usd = null.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Settlement agreements for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 identifying specific counterparties and legal matters. Legal counsel opinion on FY2026 exposure.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-004 (owner compensation normalisation $1.25M) is Challenged. The referenced third-party compensation benchmark (Sep-2025) is not in the data room. accepted_amount_usd = null.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Third-party compensation benchmark report. Payroll records showing actual founder compensation.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-007 (discontinued product losses $540K) is Challenged. Legacy products exist in dim_product but have zero invoice lines. The loss amount cannot be independently verified. accepted_amount_usd = null.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Accounting ledger or P&L extract showing Legacy On-Prem revenue and costs. Explanation of why Legacy products have zero invoice lines in structured data.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-009 (executive recruitment $310K) is Challenged. CRO existence confirmed by board minutes but search fee invoices not in data room. accepted_amount_usd = null.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Executive search firm invoices for CRO and VP Engineering. Accounting ledger entries confirming the charge.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-008 (FY2024, aborted refinancing costs $180,000) exists in structured data but is absent from the management QoE schedule (DOC-08). The reason for this omission is unexplained.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Management explanation for omission of ADJ-008 from QoE schedule.

data_quality.description: Legacy product family (PRD-016, PRD-017) exists in dim_product but has zero invoice lines in fact_invoice_line across all periods. This prevents independent verification of ADJ-007 (discontinued product losses $540,000). Either the products were never invoiced through the structured system, or the data is incomplete.
data_quality.recommendation: Investigate whether Legacy On-Prem customers were billed outside the structured invoicing system. Obtain accounting ledger data for Legacy product revenue and costs.

data_quality.description: No payroll, HR, compensation, or recruitment cost data exists in the structured Databricks sources. This prevents independent verification of ADJ-004 (owner compensation normalisation) and ADJ-009 (executive recruitment fees).
data_quality.recommendation: Request payroll records and compensation data as part of financial due diligence.

data_quality.description: No legal settlement or litigation cost data exists in structured sources. Board minutes provide the only independent corroboration of ADJ-003.
data_quality.recommendation: Request settlement agreements and legal cost ledger entries.

data_quality.description: Revenue reporting is prepared in spreadsheets from manual SQL extracts (per DOC-10 IT Overview). This introduces data integrity risk for the structured revenue data used in adjustment testing.
data_quality.recommendation: Validate structured revenue data against management accounts and audited financials.

validation.implied_multiples_null_reason: Enterprise Value not found in available authoritative deal evidence
validation.status_rationale: PARTIAL status assigned because: (1) Enterprise Value not found, preventing implied multiple calculation; (2) four challenged adjustments have unquantified accepted amounts, preventing a fully precise Team Adjusted EBITDA. Team Adjusted EBITDA of $5,150,000 represents a floor based on the single fully-accepted adjustment only.
